pages.text: Shaders (optional): Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs. Potato Shaders is light; MakeUp - Ultra Fast looks nicer. Set Off if FPS drops.
Xaero's maps: minimap in a corner, world map on M. Waypoint your base and every boss structure.
Quest book: key J (Open Quests), or right-click the Quest Book item. Rebind in Controls if it clashes.
